identity.title: Lock canonical evidence import and rebuild idempotency

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Using the same production-derived evidence fixture, prove repeated import is idempotent and repeated rebuild does not duplicate records, signals, evidence refs or change governed judgment.
human_pressure.why_now: Governance evidence is replayed during audit, recovery and operator inspection; duplicate-derived state would make reports untrustworthy.
do_not_misread: Idempotency means same evidence does not multiply derived facts.
Do not deduplicate distinct source events that happen to look similar.

machine_core.goal: Prove exact-event-id import idempotency and rebuild idempotency for canonical production-derived evidence.
red_lines: Do not collapse distinct event ids.
invariants: Second import of identical package is already-present/idempotent rather than duplicating evidence.
Repeated rebuild produces stable counts and canonical values.
Evidence refs remain traceable to original event ids.

observable_effect.assertion: Repeated import/rebuild leaves one logical evidence set and one stable canonical governance result.

proofs.assertion: Focused idempotency tests and full suite pass.

failure_semantics: Duplicate derived state is a correctness regression.
Conflicting same-id different-content evidence must not be silently treated as idempotent.

steps.title: Prove repeated import
details: Import identical production-derived package twice and assert idempotent status/counts.

steps.title: Prove repeated rebuild
details: Rebuild twice and assert stable records, signals, refs and governed result.

steps.title: Preserve conflict semantics
details: Verify same identity with conflicting content is not silently absorbed if current contract exposes that case.

acceptance: Repeated identical import does not duplicate evidence.
Repeated rebuild does not duplicate derived governance state.
